title: Taiwan Tightens Restrictions on Straits Forum Participation
description: Taiwan expands its restrictions, barring all government officials from attending China's Straits Forum, which is viewed as a platform for China's political agenda. The move signifies a stricter stance against what Taiwan perceives as attempts by China to influence its society through cross-straits exchanges.

title: Taiwan expands ban on China's straits forum, calls event CCP influence platform
description: Taiwan has widened restrictions on participation in China's annual Straits Forum, barring both central and local government officials from attending the event, as reported by Focus Taiwan.

title: Oil Market Mysteries: Navigating Unseen Forces in the Energy Sector
description: The oil market is experiencing its most significant supply shock in decades, exacerbated by geopolitical tensions between the U.S. and Iran. Despite disruptions at the Strait of Hormuz impacting global supply, market reactions remain calm, underpinned by geopolitical uncertainties and China's opaque demand dynamics. The situation is fraught with unknowns.

title: ASML: Three Risks The Market Is Completely Ignoring
description: ASML remains a lithography leader, but a rich valuation ignores High-NA EUV delays, China export risks, and Taiwan geopolitics. See why I rate ASML stock a Hold.

title: Oil Market Uncertainty Casts a Long Shadow
description: The article discusses ongoing oil supply disruptions due to heightened tensions between the U.S., Iran, and Israel, causing fluctuating oil prices. Despite the closure of the Strait of Hormuz, the market remains calm due to various unknowns. China’s oil consumption dynamics add to the uncertainty, affecting global supply-demand balance.

title: Taiwan Condemns Chinese Coast Guard Patrols as 'Provocative Act' Near Its Eastern Waters
description: The patrols followed Japan and the Philippines' announcement of maritime boundary delimitation talks, which China views as involving waters off Taiwan.

title: Oil market calm masks a host of unknowns
description: Global oil markets are experiencing an unusual calm despite a major supply shock. The Strait of Hormuz remains largely shut, impacting significant global supply. However, prices have retreated from highs. Uncertainties about global inventories, China's demand, and the true state of consumption create a precarious situation. Experts are operating with limited information, making the market's stability fragile.

title: Taiwan: China maritime operation 'provocative'
description: TAIPEI — Taiwan said on Monday that China's maritime operation in waters to the east of the self-ruled island was 'provocative' and 'expansionism in disguise.'

title: Chinese military hovered as global executives flocked to Taiwan tech show
description: TAIPEI, June 8 - As AI heavyweights including Nvidia, Intel and SK Group last week championed Taiwan's significance as a crucial hub for the global supply chain, a hostile exchange with China was brewing at sea. Read more at straitstimes.com.
